changeSet.author: bielik-lab
changeSet.comment: Corpus assistant conversations; id is the UUID of the conversation's sandbox session folder.
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE agent_conversations ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY, corpus_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES corpora(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, title TEXT, events JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]'::jsonb, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now() ); CREATE INDEX agent_conversations_corpus_idx ON agent_conversations (corpus_id, updated_at DESC);
